topic: Unrelated span merged into .NET traces on Azure
environment: ASP.NET Core on Azure App Service
symptom_pattern: Some traces contain an OPTIONS request from a platform client attached under an unrelated request, making it look like two requests were merged.
root_cause: The Azure platform's scaling health probe sends requests carrying a valid traceparent copied from a real in-flight request, and the tracer correctly continues that context.
resolution_path: Pull raw span data and compare parent/span ids and runtime-id
Identify the probe by user agent/resource
Restrict extraction to datadog style (DD_TRACE_PROPAGATION_STYLE_EXTRACT=datadog) for that app
info_needed: user agent of the odd span

qa_pairs.tse_question: What user agent does the odd span have?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Something like HttpScaleManager, from an Azure IP.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Do both spans share the same runtime-id?

customer_style.tone: detail-oriented, suspects a tracer bug, wants it escalated
